---
name: Teams inquiry
about: Alfred's open package doesn't cover what your team is accountable for
title: "Teams: "
labels: teams-inquiry
---

⚠️ This is a **public issue**. Write only what you can share publicly — no
customer names, no internal hostnames, no trace contents you haven't redacted.
If what you need to describe can't be public, say so below and we'll find a
private channel instead.

**What are you accountable for?** (the agents, roughly what they do, and to whom
you have to answer for them)

**What does the open package not cover?** Formal verdicts, verifiable policies,
multi-agent, retention, compliance export — or something not on that list, which
is the most useful answer of all.

**Scale** (how many agents, how many runs a day, roughly)

**Is there a deadline behind this?** An audit, a customer requirement, a
regulation you're preparing for — or no, it's exploratory. Both are fine
answers; they just mean different things.

**Are you using Alfred today?** If yes, what does your mandate look like. If no,
what stopped you.

---

There is no pricing page and nothing to sign — the closed-source engine is
planned, not shipped, and no date is promised. This issue is read as a signal of
what to build. See [Alfred for teams](https://adriencr81.github.io/Check-Alfred/teams/).
